title: Grilled Portuguese Pork Tenderloin Skewers
description: Tender and juicy pork tenderloin marinated in a zesty Portuguese-inspired mixture, grilled to perfection on skewers. This dish is perfect for a summer evening dinner.
instructions: In a blender or food processor, combine marinade ingredients and blend until smooth.
Place the pork tenderloin in a large zip-top plastic bag or a shallow dish. Pour the marinade over the pork, turning to coat evenly.
Seal the bag or cover the dish with plastic wrap. Refrigerate for at least 2 hours or overnight, turning occasionally.
Thread the pork tenderloin onto the skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Brush the grill with the grassy olive oil to prevent sticking.
Grill the skewers for 8-10 minutes per side, or until the pork reaches an internal temperature of 145°F (63°C).
Transfer the skewers to a plate and let rest for 5 minutes before serving.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh oregano if desired.
